name: Ryou Ginta
source:
A member of Glittering Crux's second section Vanishing Age squad. His Cybody is named Gimlok and possesses the Star Sword "Corail". His first phase ability is to possess animals, like a raven to spy on people or a snake to attack others. Ginta is also a third-year student at Southern Cross High School.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Star_Driver_characters##Glittering_Crux_Brigade]Wikipedia[/url].]
